# Korean Market Analysis (2026-09-29)
**KOSPI Position:** South Korea's KOSPI index stands at 6879.01 [3277e810], tracking alongside global equity weakness driven by rising rate expectations.
**Global Headwinds:** US 10-year yields elevated at 5.24% [0d0f5cec] with VIX at 16.07 [1aa15b0a], while the US dollar strengthens at 101.227 [2df88641], creating headwinds for Korean exporters. Oil prices remain elevated at 93.76 USD/barrel [635361da], sustaining inflation pressures that keep rate-hike bets alive [per Reuters, WSJ, Bloomberg headlines].
**Risk Sentiment:** Fear & Greed index at 34 [Fear&Greed score] signals fear-leaning conditions, suggesting defensive positioning may persist.
**What Could Shift This:** Monitor whether US rate expectations decline (watch 10Y yields), or if geopolitical easing reduces oil prices, which would ease pressure on both global equities and the Korean won. Check KOSPI's export-sensitive sectors (semiconductors, automotive) against upcoming earnings and Fed communications.
